textAndFormatting.notes: Broadly complete, but contains repeated Eclosion/Evacuation errors, punctuation normalization, and questionable text recovery from partly obscured material.

iconsAndSymbols.notes: Correctly handled several ordinary inline icons but misclassified every non-glossary player-count emblem as character, rendered the objective-choice glyph as A, and inserted a pink symbol into Perimeter Clearing.

discipline.notes: It reported several genuine uncertainties, but its confident player-count and symbol assignments violate the morphology-first rule.

structure.notes: Columns, fan, panel rows, and explanatory-note layout were represented well.

completeness.notes: Most visible sections and panels were covered, although some obscured/clipped scope decisions are inconsistent.

identityAndCategory.notes: Correctly recognized a composite objective/reference help sheet, but did not establish the page-2 identity and called GAME TERMS the title.

visibleTextFidelity.notes: Recovered substantial left-column and objective text but included questionable reconstructions such as 'The number 5 must NOT Survive' and omitted much panel text.

uncertaintyDiscipline.notes: Correctly deferred and explicitly flagged clipped panels and non-glossary glyphs.

KnownUnresolvedDetails.notes: Caught player-count and Life Support-like glyph uncertainty and clipping, but treated the square A glyph as text rather than separately flagging it.

identity.notes: Correct Life Support Active facility-token identity.

category.notes: Proposed generic map instead of the established tokens/status category.

discipline.notes: No invented text or unrelated function.

visibleDescription.notes: Pixel description is concise and accurate.

NoInventedExactIdentity.notes: It did not claim an Adult identity, bag role, or exact filename.

uncertaintyDiscipline.notes: Identity confidence was low, but uncertainties was empty and overall/category confidence were high.

decision.notes: Promoted despite low identity confidence and no canonical component function/category.

orientation.notes: Rotation-irrelevant art was acceptably treated as upright.

c12.criticalFailure: False promotion of deliberately ambiguous canonical classification.
